answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 59 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The dune register is checked at draw time, jade lists the eligible set, and lotus seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 59 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Each impostor pays 12 dollars up front. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
